Definition: from G3627; compassionate:--merciful, of tender mercy.
BiblicalUsage: Oiktirmon means merciful, compassionate, of tender mercy. Jesus says in Luke 6:36, be merciful, as your Father is merciful, and James 5:11 says the Lord is very pitiful and of tender mercy, seen in the end of Job.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mercy is the family likeness of God, and the merciful prove whose children they are.
